name: Burning Lions
supply_note: 7 = cw721 num_tokens / all_tokens [1..7] (Chainscope, owner 2026-09-26). The mirror walks 1…supply, so this is the minted count.
stated_supply_note: 12 one-of-ones per the pride (owner 2026-09-22). Five are not on this contract. The minter is the Enterprise treasury, now retired, so they were most likely never minted — pending Lion DAO confirmation.
minter_note: the Enterprise treasury / festival receiver (cw721 minter query)
rarity_note: one-of-ones: every token is unique, so no rarity rank. If the metadata carries attributes they are shown as descriptions, not ranked.

images.mode_note: each token carries its own token_uri (ipfs://bafkrei…, extension empty), not a folder CID. mirror-images 1.2.0 reads nft_info per token, follows token_uri → metadata → image / animation_url, and keeps each file's real type.
images.media_note: file names differ per token (1.gif, 3.mp4, 3.anim.mp4 …), so the site reads media_index for them instead of a {id}.png pattern. gif/png/webp render as ; mp4/webm/mov render as
images.gateways_note: extra {cid}/{path} gateway templates tried before the public list — a gateway that pins these files (Lion DAO's, if they have one) goes here, or in the IPFS_GATEWAY secret when it needs a token
images.proxies_note: last resort when IPFS serves nothing: Atrium's un-tokened image proxy (the same one that served Pixel Lions before the mirror). A proxy copy is labeled in metadata.json and may be a still, not the animation.
images.availability_note: 2026-09-26: public IPFS gateways time out on #1's token_uri with 'No providers were found' — nobody on the network is pinning the file right now. If the Action cannot fetch it either, the files have to come from whoever holds the originals (Lion DAO / the artist) or a marketplace cache.

governance.staking_note: no staking module known for Burning Lions

origin.how_won: raffle weighted by each wallet's own ROAR burn; Lion DAO matched community burns 10x from its treasury (capped 8B a month)
origin.original_winners_note: each token's first transfer out of the minter = its winner. Needs the contract's transfer history (archive node); until then the site shows today's holder only.

marketplaces_note: listed where the pixeLions trade; whether Burning Lions are actually listed on each is not verified yet
